subject: The Weekly Widget #42: Why Acme Corp is betting on refurbished factory robots
body:
Hi readers,

This week Acme Corp announced it will buy 300 refurbished assembly robots instead of new ones. Acme's operations lead said refurbished units cost about 40% less and can be delivered in six weeks instead of nine months.

The catch: maintenance. Acme is signing a five-year service contract with Globex Robotics, which means the savings depend on Globex keeping spare parts in stock.

What it means for small manufacturers: (1) used automation is becoming a real procurement category, (2) service contracts now matter more than the sticker price, (3) watch for financing products built around refurbished equipment.

Also this week: a short guide on how to compare total cost of ownership for new vs refurbished machines.

Read the full issue: https://newsletter.example.com/issues/42

See you next Friday,
The Weekly Widget team
